class.name: LocalizedAudioStream
class.brief_description: An audio stream with a different stream per locale.
class.description: An audio stream playing a different stream for each locale, such as voice lines. It can be used wherever an [AudioStream] is, and the stream of the locale is played each time playback starts. A stream already playing keeps playing when the locale changes. The resource of the locale is chosen like translations: the one of the current locale, or else of its language (for example [code]pt[/code] for [code]pt_BR[/code]), or else of the [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/fallback] locale, or else the default one. In the editor, the preview locale is used, or else the fallback locale. It changes when [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed] is emitted. [b]Note:[/b] The settings of the streams, such as looping, are set on the stream of each locale. [b]Note:[/b] The streams of all the locales are loaded with this resource and stay in memory, so the locale can change at once. For large resources, such as long voice lines, the remaps of the localization settings of the project load only the resource of the current locale, when the scene using it is loaded.

method.name: get_current_stream
method.description: Returns the stream used for the current locale.

members.member: The stream used when no stream of [member streams] matches the locale.
The stream of each locale, the keys being locale codes such as [code]en[/code] or [code]pt_BR[/code].
